# Indikator 6

Indikator 6 measures the proportion of ADHD treatment courses that include medical treatment for the [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]]. The data reveals significant geographical variation across Danish regions and specific psychiatric facilities, highlighting disparities in treatment practices over recent years.

## Leaders and Trailers
[[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] consistently emerges as the national leader in medical treatment rates for ADHD. In the 2023 report, it achieved an 87% rate [^src1], and in the 2024 report, it maintained a high performance with 82% in 2023/24 and 87% in 2022/23 [^src2]. At the facility level, [[bornholm-bup-ambulatorium|Bornholm: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] is the top-performing department, reaching 86% in 2023/24 [^src2].

Conversely, the lowest rates are typically found in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]]. The 2023 report recorded Midtjylland at just 53% [^src1]. By the 2023/24 period in the 2024 report, Sjælland and Midtjylland remained the trailers at 56% and 58%, respectively [^src2].

## Trends Across Dated Sections
Comparing the 2023 and 2024 reports shows a general upward trend in the national average for medical treatment rates. The national rate (Danmark) rose from 62-63% in the earlier periods [^src1] to 68% in 2023/24 [^src2]. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] demonstrated notable improvement, jumping from 54% [^src1] to 67% [^src2]. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] also saw an increase from 66% [^src1] to 72% [^src2]. However, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] experienced a slight decline from 87% [^src1] to 82% [^src2], while [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] saw only marginal gains, moving from 53% to 58% [^src1][^src2] and 55% to 56% [^src1][^src2], respectively. No specific numerical targets or thresholds are defined in the provided data to evaluate met or missed goals.

## Outliers
At the departmental level, [[bornholm-bup-ambulatorium|Bornholm: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] is a positive outlier, significantly outperforming its parent [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] average of 67% [^src2]. Other facilities in the Capital Region, such as [[glostrup-bup-ambulatorium|Glostrup: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] (68%) and [[hillerod-psykiatrisk-ambulatorium-boern-og-unge|Hillerød: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] (69%), align closely with the regional average [^src2]. In contrast, [[bispebjerg-bup-ambulatorium|Bispebjerg: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] underperforms relative to the regional average, scoring 61% [^src2]. Additionally, the facility 'Børne-Unge Psyk. Reg.fkt. 40.R' reports a 100% rate, but this is a statistical outlier driven by a negligible sample size, as evidenced by its extremely wide 95% confidence interval of 3-100% [^src2].
